maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The top row consists of four distinct high-contrast clusters arranged in a near-linear horizontal orientation, situated approximately 1.5 times the average cluster diameter superior to the primary dense vibrissae row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95% dark pixel saturation across the nasal apex and alae, with negligible pale pixel distribution localized to the ventral margins of the nostrils.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint longitudinal linear scar is visible on the bridge of the nose, roughly equidistant between the medial canthus and the rhinarium.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive black pigmentation on the posterior surface of the pinnae; high-contrast white fur localized on the mandibular region.
